title: SK Hynix says it plans to invest ~$12.85B in a new fab in South Korea for advanced packaging to meet AI demand for HBM, with construction starting this month (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: SK Hynix says it plans to invest ~$12.85B in a new fab in South Korea for advanced packaging to meet AI demand for HBM, with construction starting this month — SK Hynix (000660.KS) said on Wednesday it plans to invest 19 trillion won ($12.85 billion) in a new manufacturing plant in South Korea …
